scope: Controlled CPU images with known masks: 100 ROIs x 6000 frames, one cold FOV and four warm FOVs; full method-bound analysis, persistence and offline reuse
measurement_note: Sequential fresh-process cases; single samples without uncertainty intervals. Cold means backend preparation, not an empty disk/Numba cache. No performance runs or regression jobs ran concurrently.
memory_note: Parent lifetime high-water RSS plus one-second simultaneous process-tree RSS. Validation/offline graphs are included; stages separate them. Resource trackers count as descendants even for one analysis process. Sampled summed RSS can miss brief peaks and counts shared pages per process; it is not unique physical memory.

results.scope: controlled images, known ROI masks, actual FOV pool, full analysis, SQLite persistence and offline re-analysis
results.stage_note: Aggregate stage times can overlap across FOV threads; cascade_caller includes queue/lock waiting; ROI helpers are subsets of trace_finalization; FOV population timers are subsets of fov_analysis_total.

process_tree_memory.scope: simultaneous parent + descendant RSS, including resource trackers
process_tree_memory.note: Sampling can miss short peaks; shared pages count in each process. This is a summed-RSS comparison, not unique physical memory. The ps sampler is excluded. Stage transitions are approximate.
